node.title: SPI stage 2: points of D_j on components — low-dim components contribute poly
node.statement: For each component V of dim below threshold: #(V cap D_j) <= poly(n). HONEST NOTE: this is where the core resurfaces in the SPI dialect — D_j is a special finite set, not generic points, so Lang-Weil-type counting does not apply verbatim; the divisor structure must enter.
node.notes: CONDITIONAL (Pro Theorem J): conj_f (PROVED) + hankel_slope_large_sieve => R2 with B = C_F + C_Sigma. Honest: the sieve IS R2 factorized — the gain is that the fiber factor is now settled by Conjecture F and the residue is purely the XR exchange wall, where the campaign has machinery (Johnson expansion, exchange ledgers). | Wired as an alt route into r2_rigidity (Theorem J). When the diffuse-shadow leaf lands, this chain greens, r2_rigidity discharges (reqs already all green), and the general R2 becomes available to the terminal cluster alongside the compiled XR route.
